summary: Granite has been fine-tuned on Modal, but no accuracy improvement has been demonstrated yet. The initial training study used GSM8K; additional source imports and teacher-data stages are tracked separately.

dataset_coverage.name: GSM8K
dataset_coverage.used_for: Ranking probes, teacher questions, LoRA training examples, and development evaluation. Downloaded from the canonical GitHub source; not a claim that all Hugging Face datasets were processed.

dataset_coverage.name: Alpaca
dataset_coverage.actual_source: Earlier project discussion; no ingestion artifact for this study
dataset_coverage.used_for: Mentioned in an older direction, then explicitly superseded by the GSM8K scope.

dataset_coverage.name: open-r1/OpenR1-Math-220k
dataset_coverage.used_for: Bounded seeded scan of256 training records found zero complete verified numeric word-problem traces meeting the768-response-token limit; cached artifacts retained. Not used for Granite training. This sample does not establish that the full dataset has no suitable records.

dataset_coverage.name: nvidia/OpenMathInstruct-2
dataset_coverage.used_for: 600 source training prompts imported; 523 teacher responses passed the verifier. Reference type: synthetic majority-vote references. New-cohort Granite training/evaluation remains separate from teacher-data collection.

dataset_coverage.name: open-thoughts/OpenThoughts-114k
dataset_coverage.used_for: Later skill-diversity source: use math-only records from its DeepSeek-R1 reasoning data. Mixed domains and long traces require filtering; not yet imported.

dataset_coverage.name: ChilleD/SVAMP
dataset_coverage.used_for: 600 source training prompts imported; 571 teacher responses passed the verifier. Reference type: human dataset answers. New-cohort Granite training/evaluation remains separate from teacher-data collection.

dataset_coverage.name: math-ai/TemplateGSM
dataset_coverage.used_for: 600 source training prompts imported; 471 teacher responses passed the verifier. Reference type: procedural references. New-cohort Granite training/evaluation remains separate from teacher-data collection.

dataset_coverage.name: Broader Hugging Face source audit
dataset_coverage.used_for: 40 repositories sampled, with 312 complete training rows across 37 declared families. These samples are not entire datasets or evidence of training across all domains.

model.name: ibm-granite/granite-4.2-3b
model.training_method: LoRA adapters on a pinned 3B Granite checkpoint, on Modal A100 workers; not full-parameter training and not the earlier local 8B model.

completed.title: GSM8K training data prepared
completed.detail: 7,473 official training records were prepared. 128 questions were reserved as ranking probes; the remainder supplied candidate questions. This is one dataset, not a survey of all Hugging Face repositories.

completed.title: Prompt ranking and duplicate pruning completed
completed.detail: 7,344 candidate question prompts were scored by BM25 against 128 training probes after duplicate pruning. This is relevance ranking, not evidence of causal training value, and it does not mean every question was sent to DeepSeek or used for training.

completed.title: Granite was actually fine-tuned on Modal
completed.detail: The A100 smoke test completed 12 LoRA updates on 12 teacher examples, saved the adapter, and reloaded it. This changed adapter parameters; it was not full-parameter training or evidence of generalization improvement. Modal evidence requires account access.

completed.title: DeepSeek teacher examples generated and verified
completed.detail: 128 candidate responses were collected through the DeepSeek API; 120 passed the strict final-answer verifier. Rejected outputs were preserved and excluded from both training arms.

completed.title: Ranked and random LoRA adapters trained on Modal
completed.detail: Separate adapters each received 32 examples and 32 updates. Ranked used 3,260 supervised tokens; random used 2,534. The budgets matched examples and updates, not tokens. Modal evidence requires account access.

completed.title: First accuracy comparison completed: a tie
completed.detail: Original Granite: 13/16. BM25-trained Granite: 13/16. Random-trained Granite: 13/16. This single-seed development pilot demonstrated no accuracy gain; the official test set was not used.

completed.title: DeepSeek measured on the identical 16 questions
completed.detail: DeepSeek Pro scored 15/16. The Granite variants scored 13/16 on these same questions. DeepSeek used thinking and a 4096-token cap; Granite used non-thinking and a 512-token cap. API and GPU timing scopes differ.

completed.title: DeepSeek side of the new 64-question benchmark completed
completed.detail: DeepSeek scored 63/64, including 1 truncated response counted as a failure. Do not compare this 64-question score with Granite's earlier 16-question score.

completed.title: Original Granite baseline completed on the same 64 questions
completed.detail: Original Granite scored 58/64, with 2 truncated outputs counted as failures. DeepSeek scored 63/64 on those identical questions. This is a baseline comparison, not evidence that training improved Granite.

completed.title: 64-question Granite benchmark fully recovered
completed.detail: All three Granite checkpoint evaluations on the same 64 monitoring questions are saved. This is development monitoring, not the official final test.

completed.title: New multi-source DeepSeek teaching pool completed
completed.detail: 1,800/1,800 DeepSeek responses saved; 1,565 passed complete-response/reference-match checks, supplying 150,750 supervised answer tokens. Sources are SVAMP, TemplateGSM and OpenMath arithmetic augmentation. Human dataset answers, procedural results and synthetic majority-vote references remain distinct; reference match does not independently prove every reasoning step correct. This is teacher-data preparation, not completed Granite training on the new cohort.

completed.title: First equal-token random versus skill experiment completed
completed.detail: seed 42: random 55/64, skill and diversity 53/64; seed 43: random 57/64, skill and diversity 56/64. Every arm completed 32,768 supervised tokens and 32 matched optimizer updates on the same 64 monitoring questions. The skill heuristic did not beat random in either seed. Targeted gradient selection and the new source cohort are separate experiments.

current_work.title: Original 64-question Granite attempt
current_work.detail: The original attempt reached its application deadline before completing all checkpoints. Completed phase outputs were preserved; this is not a completed comparison across all checkpoints.

current_work.title: Resume of unfinished 64-question evaluations
current_work.detail: All required outputs on the 64 monitoring questions are saved. It is a separate attempt and should reuse completed outputs instead of rerunning them.

current_work.title: Larger 120-example Granite training round
current_work.detail: All required outputs on the 64 monitoring questions are saved. Its purpose is to measure whether more verified data helps; improvement is not guaranteed.

current_work.title: New verified teacher pool for token-matched controls
current_work.detail: 512/512 separate training questions answered; 477 passed eligibility checks, with 55,738 available answer tokens. Uses DeepSeek V4-Pro non-thinking concise responses; original raw answers remain private. Collection is not a completed training experiment.

current_work.title: Verify the new multi-source arithmetic teaching pool
current_work.detail: 1,800/1,800 DeepSeek responses saved; 1,565 passed complete-response/reference-match checks, supplying 150,750 supervised answer tokens. Sources are SVAMP, TemplateGSM and OpenMath arithmetic augmentation. Human dataset answers, procedural results and synthetic majority-vote references remain distinct; reference match does not independently prove every reasoning step correct. This is teacher-data preparation, not completed Granite training on the new cohort.

current_work.title: Equal-token random training, seed 42
current_work.detail: Measured 55/64 numeric answers, with 0 truncated outputs counted as failures. Completed 32,768 supervised tokens and 32 token-weighted updates. This is adaptive development monitoring, not a final-test result.

current_work.title: Equal-token skill and diversity training, seed 42
current_work.detail: Measured 53/64 numeric answers, with 1 truncated outputs counted as failures. Completed 32,768 supervised tokens and 32 token-weighted updates. This is adaptive development monitoring, not a final-test result.

current_work.title: Equal-token random training, seed 43
current_work.detail: Measured 57/64 numeric answers, with 0 truncated outputs counted as failures. Completed 32,768 supervised tokens and 32 token-weighted updates. This is adaptive development monitoring, not a final-test result.

current_work.title: Equal-token skill and diversity training, seed 43
current_work.detail: Measured 56/64 numeric answers, with 0 truncated outputs counted as failures. Completed 32,768 supervised tokens and 32 token-weighted updates. This is adaptive development monitoring, not a final-test result.

current_work.title: First student-aware equal-token experiment
current_work.detail: seed 42: random 55/64, skill and diversity 53/64; seed 43: random 57/64, skill and diversity 56/64. Every arm completed 32,768 supervised tokens and 32 matched optimizer updates on the same 64 monitoring questions. The skill heuristic did not beat random in either seed. Targeted gradient selection and the new source cohort are separate experiments.

current_work.title: Model-gradient data selection on the new math cohort
current_work.detail: A confirmed Modal call is collecting candidate gradients; 208/3,130 features reported saved. 1,541 new-cohort candidates and 24 separate selection-development targets; 2 planned warmup checkpoints. CountSketch gradient alignment is an approximate selection signal, not a measured Granite accuracy gain.

current_work.title: Capped Granite API trial
current_work.detail: API source and quota controls are prepared and locally checked. No public model endpoint is deployed. It requires a chosen evaluated checkpoint, completed research GPU work, a serving reservation and an expiring request quota.

not_done: Robust or final-test Granite accuracy improvement has not been established.
Completed Granite training/evaluation on the new multi-source math cohort; source imports and teacher collection are separate stages.
Robust or final-test evidence that the new selection method outperforms random.
Official GSM8K test evaluation of a final frozen checkpoint.
Public Granite model-serving API and Vercel deployment.
